comment.narrative: Implementation of a comprehensive advocacy media and onthe ground awareness campaign on population and development issues under the slogan For the rights of Your Children... Calculate It Right across the 27 governorates from June to August 2023. The Population and development campaign was cofunded by the European Union EU Delegation and the Government of UK as well as the Ministry of Social Solidarity Fund for NGOs and CSOs. The project has contracted seven networks and news websites and each news network works on boosting viewership for the campaign banner news articles posters and reports. o The campaign has successfully achieved the following outreach targets73940 awareness seminars with a total number of 1253402 beneficiaries. 2281344 families reached through doortodoor awareness visits implemented by social workers Raedat. 54 million beneficiaries reached through contracted national media websites. MoSS onground and media campaign for Combatting Child Marriage during the period from June August 2022 with an aggregate outreach Field Campaign implemented by MoSS directorates community social workers and Project contracted Civil Society Organizations reaching the following beneficiaries on the ground 1614868 beneficiaries from seminars and awareness raising sessions organized by MOSS directorates in villages and districts of the 27 governorates. 1286801 families benefited from doortodoor visits by MoSS community social workers. 71544 beneficiaries from campaign activities implemented by project contracted NGOs in 12 governorates Cairo Giza Qalyubia Matrouh North Sinai South Sinai Port Said Suez Ismailia Sharqiya Sohag Qena and El Wadi El Geded in cooperation with CDAs to ensure beneficiaries in most vulnerable villages and districts receive campaigns messages.
